title: CaLR：面向鲁棒扩散推理的因果潜在修正框架
summary: CaLR将推理重构为受约束的潜在优化，利用专家模型的因果拓扑矩阵与隐式微分进行梯度引导的“思维修正”，在并行生成中实现中间步骤的动态自我纠错，在复杂基准上达到扩散语言模型SOTA，并在数独等约束任务中展现更强鲁棒性。
summary_en: CaLR reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization, using a causal topology matrix from an expert model and implicit differentiation to perform gradient-guided "thought revision" for dynamic self-correction during parallel generation. It achieves SOTA DLM performance on complex benchmarks and superior robustness on constrained tasks like Sudoku.
